base_fresh.applies_to: stage 1 for every strategy and every joint-retraining stage

base_fallback.trigger: Either selected validation domain accuracy below 0.90, or a nonfinite-value FloatingPointError
base_fallback.attempt_selection: minimum raw equal-block-within-domain summed-domain validation CE

distillation.full: logit plus raw-feature KD on prior replay
distillation.lwf: logit only on current inputs; no retained training images
distillation.feature_scale: Training-fitted centered per-coordinate RMS, shared scalar

configuration.covariance_policy: Reset at each optimization epoch; rebuild after selected-state restoration from unique permitted current training plus prior replay, or accumulated training for joint retraining.

architecture.spectral_normalization: existing fc1/fc2 only; no architectural layer added

configuration.plot_policy: raw common 256-D pre-head primary; optional L2 diagnostic separately labeled; no favorable t-SNE seed/sample selection
configuration.physical_work_policy: Each logical stage uses one validation-selected training phase. Bounded fresh-fit fallback attempts use the same phase, with all attempted costs retained.
configuration.anchor_rule: Use the registered 10.0% experimental training-label mask; preserve its identities across methods, seeds, orders and material-disjoint remapping.

portable_adjustments.data_setup.py: Package-relative inputs and tensor-only NPZ loading; directly read the registered 10.0% experimental training-label partition and preserve scan roles.
portable_adjustments.launch_suite.py: Package-relative inputs, explicit GPU selection, read-only plan and explicit logit-distillation temperature T=2.
portable_adjustments.frozen_support/models.py: Pre-head feature docstring corrected; computational AST unchanged.
portable_adjustments.verify_inputs.py: New read-only data, mask and scope verification command.
portable_adjustments.training_engine.py: Single-phase training with replay, logit distillation and pre-head feature distillation; validation cross-entropy selects the stage state.
